verdict.rationale: Stripe publishes an official OpenAPI specification repository for its API, which Stripe Terminal's API-based integration is part of, so a machine-readable spec is downloadable. The only evidence is a single README line: it does not confirm that Terminal resources are covered, and probes of the conventional docs-hosted spec URLs all returned 404. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that Terminal endpoints are included in the spec, documented download/discovery path from the Terminal docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of using the spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: This repository contains OpenAPI specifications for Stripe's API.
Terminal supports an API-based integration in addition to SDKs for Android, iOS, JavaScript, and React Native.
